docs: Tooling-only config, read by dependency-cruiser. It exists because the graph spans two resolution schemes: workspace packages resolve through package exports, while apps/web resolves its own '@/*' alias via its private tsconfig. dependency-cruiser takes exactly one tsConfig, and has no 'alias' option, so this file unions the two. Without it every apps/web import fails to resolve, the app's modules all look orphaned, and — the real problem — the 'web-must-not-import-internal-contracts' rule silently never fires, because the graph would hold no edges out of apps/web at all. Never extend this from application code.
